title: Managed Database: credit claim days
content:
## Tier basis
Managed Database credit claim days is specified by contracted tier. Inclusive outage-claim filing period after the incident closes; calendar days integer.

| Contracted tier | Credit claim days |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore | 30 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 4 vCore | 30 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 8 vCore | 30 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 16 vCore | 30 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 32 vCore | 30 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore | 30 |

## Tier comparison
For credit claim days, Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore and Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore use the same declared value of 30.
